expectations.text: Explains the book's three-step method: estimate family expenses if you die (immediate and future), subtract assets/income sources, insure the gap
Says the book considers credit-life insurance usually not a good buy and that one larger policy beats several small ones
expectations.evidence: credit-life not a good buy; one large policy
